about: The quiz set of images/south-america-quiz: the single source of truth for codes, names, capitals, marker points and which entries are clickable.
id: Natural Earth ADM0_A3 code (also the element id in site/map.svg); GUF (ISO 3166-1 for French Guiana) is split out of Natural Earth's FRA feature by tools/build_map.py.

name, capital: English short forms per the EU Interinstitutional Style Guide, diacritics kept. Bolivia: Sucre is the constitutional capital, La Paz the seat of government; the quiz asks both (tools/README.md).
of: the state a territory belongs to; the page shows it after the name, e.g. 'French Guiana (France)'.

quiz: false makes an entry context land (drawn, never clickable); missing = true. Flip it and regenerate (tools/README.md, Quiz set). French Guiana clickable, the Falkland Islands context land: the owner's call (2026-11-02).
marker: [lon, lat] for entries too small to tap at the full view: a ring is drawn there with a generous hit area (only for quiz entries).
Everything else in the map window (Central America, the Caribbean incl. Trinidad and Tobago, South Georgia, Antarctica, ...) is context land.
